item.title: Workers Rescued from Trench in Bethesda, MD
item.description: Montgomery County firefighters and technical rescue crews worked for more than two hours to free the workers.

item.title: Firefighters Battle Barge Blaze in Delaware Bay
item.description: The barge was moved to shallow water late Tuesday so firefighters could operate while it was moored.

item.title: Pension Bill Could Lower Retirement Age for CA Firefighters, Cops
item.description: The longer firefighters are on the front lines, the more likely they will develop job-related illnesses, such as cancer, said Brian Rice, president of California Professional Firefighters.

item.title: Ex-Saginaw County, MI, Firefighter Pleads No Contest to Sexual Abuse of Teens
item.description: The former Albee Township firefighter groomed the teenage boys with drugs, alcohol and vape pens.

item.title: Man Killed, 11 Hurt in Crash Involving FDNY Tower Ladder
item.description: The FDNY rig was responding to a call when it collided with a van before hitting a small bus, killing an elderly passenger.

item.title: Some Los Angeles Firefighters Wanted to Continue Mop-up of Lachman Fire
item.description: Despite Los Angeles firefighters' recent testimony, a fire official said the case against the alleged arsonist should continue.

item.title: Potato Chip, Soda Warehouse Destroyed in Five-Alarm Blaze: FDNY
item.description: The Universal Food Distribution building collapsed and spread to two other industrial structures in Brooklyn.

item.title: Watchdogs Want Probe of CAL FIRE after Deadly Fireworks Blast
item.description: Residents Against Illegal Fireworks are asking the governor for an independent review the state fire marshal's actions before and after the explosion.

item.title: Probe of Deadly House Fire Underway in Havre de Grace, MD
item.description: The son of the couple killed was awaken by a smoke alarm and escaped through a window of the Havre de Grace home.

item.title: Richlandtown, PA, Fire Police Officer Dies while Responding to Call
item.description: Richlandtown Fire Police Officer Todd Koch suffered a medical emergency and died despite immediate intervention.
